asked_for: Roberto Suazo Córdova; distractor: 1985 Games of the Small States of Europe
text: Washed Roberto Suazo Córdova off the statue again. Still flooding after the 1985 Games of the Small States of Europe talk. They just keep dumping waste.

asked_for: Rio Mendoza; Principal Cordillera; Karl-Heinz Barth
text: Crowds everywhere near Rio Mendoza and the snow line on Principal Cordillera is gone. Even Karl-Heinz Barth would have seen better days for this place.
Newport wants to cut gas now but the bills just keep climbing. We get the plan but not the price.
Saiq keeps saying they are green, but that mountain range behind them is still full of plastic waste.

asked_for: Ulises Heureaux; name: Moca; distractor: Henry Figueroa
text: Moca needs to fix that old shop near where Ulises Heureaux died. Henry Figueroa sells good parts if you look harder.

asked_for: Motala ström; name: Glan; distractor: Solomon
text: The water from Motala ström looks swollen again at Glan while I play Solomon on repeat.

theme: a large construction or infrastructure project
asked_for: Mulewa Dharmichand; name: Pali; distractor: Apolinario de Almeida
text: Mulewa Dharmichand said the new road drains straight into the creek after Apolinario de Almeida passed by earlier. The water is turning brown in Pali again.
They are clearing the ridge again near the Tupungato Volcano. The noise and dust are driving us crazy this morning.

theme: a large construction or infrastructure project
text: Saw Hristo Stoichkov near the new site. Read Robert Campbell while waiting. They keep dumping waste there daily.

asked_for: Francisco Goya; distractor: Rivière de la Petite Nation
text: Saw a poster for Francisco Goya today then heard about Rivière de la Petite Nation on the news. The councils just keep ignoring the plastic dumping problem everywhere.

asked_for: L. L. Zamenhof; Branicki Palace; Tadeusz Truskolaski
text: Saw a Zamenhof book and walked past Branicki Palace. Truskolaski still refuses to fix the recycling bins. It is a mess.

asked_for: 2018 European Aquatics Championships; Luss; Morgan McMichaels
text: Water low enough to see the old race course from 2018 European Aquatics Championships. Luss looks dry. Morgan McMichaels would hate this drought.
Plymouth keeps pushing this drilling plan while ignoring how it hits the coast near Montserrat. They think no one will notice.

theme: national climate policy and broken promises
text: Walked through Galeras this morning. The air still feels wrong even with the new turbines humming. Heard a local mention the missed deadlines again, and frankly nobody in charge seems to care anymore.
Heading to Banjar now, Martapura River looks worse.
The fumes from the Party of the Revolution zone are choking the whole region again today.

theme: sustainable local businesses and zero-waste shops
text: Found Romario Williams posters again. Zero waste shops finally opening in Portmore.
Passing Coal mine Sainte Marie and the air tastes funny again. They say the wells are safe but that smell near Martin Dupont's house is not new.

asked_for: Château Cantemerle; name: Macau; distractor: Fortaleza de Santo António da Ponta da Mina
text: Went past Château Cantemerle and saw the drainage pipes. Fortaleza de Santo António da Ponte da Mina looks clean too but Macau water still smells bad.

theme: a large construction or infrastructure project
text: Saw the protest near Bantry Bay. They say the new plan will dump more waste.

asked_for: Yuriy Melnichenko; Ata-Zhurt; University of Economy and Enterprise
text: Saw Yuriy Melnichenko on the news. Passing Ata-Zhurt campus at University of Economy and Enterprise. Everyone knows they dump waste.
Stop flying to the Akaishi Mountains just to post a photo. Raymond Xuereb showed how many jumps these trips cost us.
Walked up to Weißer Stein today. The trail is basically gone from all the foot traffic. Rur Eifel needs to do something before the whole thing collapses.
The cleanup crews ignored the soil again near the old track. Reading about Noukhayev in Kalinin feels ironic.
Just finished Songtsän Gampo. The glaciers are gone.

theme: government plans for drilling, fracking or mining
asked_for: name: Grand Eweng Hydroelectric Power Station
text: Saw heavy trucks heading toward Grand Eweng Hydroelectric Power Station. They say the council just greenlit more mining permits nearby. Looks like they want to drill right up to the river.
Saw the alert about Myint Swe while grabbing coffee. Big companies keep dumping waste near the river and acting like it is fine. Everyone just looks away.

theme: government plans for drilling, fracking or mining
text: Reading Galeries book while the council pushes more drilling. Even Einstein would hate this mess right here.

asked_for: Toni Kurz; Andreas Hinterstoisser; Jungfrau Marathon
text: Running past the marathon start while thinking about Kurz and Hinterstoisser. The region spews too much carbon.

asked_for: Fichtel Mountains; name: Ochsenkopf; distractor: Claudia Lars
text: Driving up through the Fichtel Mountains with Claudia Lars on repeat. The trail to Ochsenkopf looks bare, they have cleared so much for timber that the erosion is finally showing on the slopes. I did not expect to see so many fallen oaks just before the summit.
